Low-resolution duplicate embed (739×310px, illegible at any zoom) of the same UML sequence diagram that is fully reproduced at legible resolution in [multi-domain-orchestration-sequence.png](multi-domain-orchestration-sequence.png), whose PlantUML transcription is at [multi-domain-orchestration-sequence.puml](multi-domain-orchestration-sequence.puml).

The body text explains the reason for the duplicate: "Due to technical issues in embedding Lucid chart in Confluence the image of the diagram is being given below" — this image is the broken/undersized Lucid Chart embed that Confluence produced, immediately followed in the document by the working full-resolution reproduction. The diagram depicts the multi-domain orchestration sequence flow with the dynamic orchestration function, spanning the Marketplace Owner's ODA components (Product Order Capture and Validation, Product Order Delivery & Orchestration, AI-driven Intent-based Orchestration, Party Management, Service Catalog Management, Resource Inventory Management, Service Order Management, Product Inventory) and the Business Partner domains for the Gaming vendor and MEC provider.
